reference: Actual frozen original GGML graph constructors and CPU execution, one thread; generated before Rust changes and comparisons.
contracts: F32 SiLU, SwiGLU, GELU_QUICK and GEGLU_QUICK use each source row's GNU SSE2 prefix and scalar tail; MSVC scalar profile is separate.
F16/BF16 scalar/table activation controls must not acquire the F32 vector policy.
NORM contiguous-inner-axis variance uses the source profile; strided inner-axis NORM and RMS_NORM retain separate reductions.
System ERF captures cover raw binary16 and bfloat16 words plus dense and arbitrary F32 inputs through actual GELU_ERF/GEGLU_ERF graphs.
Unary SOFTPLUS is log1pf(expf(x)); Mamba's separate helper uses logf(1+expf(x)).
No expected value was obtained from Rust; all comparisons require exact bytes for this target-specific corpus.
Nearest-even and gradual underflow; NaN words are carried as raw input bytes. Floating exception flag parity is outside the tensor API.
